## portcheck tui

Live, interactive view of ports (the default in a terminal)

### Synopsis

Open a live, interactive view of local sockets and their processes.

Move with the arrow keys, filter with /, switch protocols with tab, toggle
listening-only with l, sort with s/S, stop the selected process with x
(K to force-kill, after confirmation), and press ? for all keys.

```
portcheck tui [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help                help for tui
      --interval duration   refresh interval (default 2s)
```
